capabilities: Create a per-note attachment folder next to each note and move pasted images into it
Download remote images in Markdown notes and Canvas files, replacing links with local files
Browse and manage attachments via a File Explorer tree and an Attachment Manager view
Scan .md and .canvas files for broken or misplaced attachment paths and repair them with a dry-run preview
Toggle folder visibility in File Explorer and clean up empty attachment folders
extras: Requires Obsidian 1.8.7 or newer. README documents privacy behavior (runs locally, no telemetry; network only for explicit remote image downloads) and notes it temporarily adjusts the vault's newLinkFormat setting while enabled, restoring it on unload.
motivation: The author wanted a single plugin keeping attachments predictable: one folder per note beside the note, low-friction local downloading of remote images, and maintenance tools for existing vaults.
problem: Obsidian's default attachment handling scatters pasted files in shared folders and leaves remote images external, making attachments hard to track when notes move or get archived.

summary: Per-note attachment manager that creates a folder next to each note, moves pasted images into it, downloads remote images, and repairs attachment paths.
